description: This is a PHP class file defining a deprecated view class `AOD_IndexViewIndexData` for the SuiteCRM application. The class extends `SugarView` and implements a `display()` method that retrieves index data, counts, and displays index-related information, including handling failed index events with a list view.

classes.name: AOD_IndexViewIndexData
classes.description: A deprecated view class responsible for displaying index data and failed indexing records in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves index statistics, counts, and displays index data. If there are failed index events, it displays a list view of these failures.
